mechanism_narrative: A higher current value of the CPIAUCSL inflation index predicts lower S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as elevated inflation erodes real corporate profits and forces central banks to maintain restrictive monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates for equity valuation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate and deceleration in employment growth (PAYEMS) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of UNRATE and PAYEMS on SPX 60-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in any 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When new housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1250.0, it signals a housing market contraction that reduces consumer confidence and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is below 1250.0, or the Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher current level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity and corporate capacity utilization, which supports stronger earnings growth and predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 700000.0 million dollars signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS is below 700000.0, or the Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher current unemployment rate (UNRATE) is associated with reduced consumer spending and lower corporate earnings growth, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is above 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 signals a contraction in economic output and reduced corporate capacity utilization, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 100.0, or the Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
